summary: GeneralPurposeEstimate::new rounds up by adding 7 for chunk counts and 3 for decoded-length estimates before division. These additions overflow near usize::MAX and panic, including through the public decoded_len_estimate function. The fix divides first and adds a remainder indicator, preserving rounding without overflow. The regression test added by the fix checks both estimates against u128 calculations at both ends of the usize range. Reversing the constructor is expected to panic first at encoded_len = usize::MAX - 6. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: Overflow when calculating number of chunks in input
